name: keep-coding
description: Evidence-gated, token-efficient durable memory for long-running coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Keep large agent projects coherent, efficient, and verified.
interface.longDescription: Turns large project prompts into adaptive durable contracts, dependency-aware phases, semantic impact analysis, evidence-backed checkpoints, approvals, budgets, delta context delivery, and resumable cross-runtime state.
defaultPrompt: Build this project end to end and keep every phase verified.
Continue the active project from its latest checkpoint without retransmitting unchanged context.
